thread:
carol-idp: Heads up — after yesterday's IdP cert rollover a few EU tenants report SAML assertions getting rejected with a decryption/encryption algo error.
carol-idp: Error from SP logs: `DecryptionError: unsupported encryption algorithm: rsa-1_5`
alice.m: Hmm. Did we harden xmlsec policy recently? we should support rsa-oaep, but some IdPs still send rsa-1_5.
bob-sre: We switched xmlsec_policy to `strict` in the EU rollout (disabled rsa-1_5) ~2 weeks ago as mitigation for CVE-xyz.
carol-idp: I can reproduce locally if I force the assertion encryption alg to RSA1_5. stack trace:```xml
[SAML] EncryptedAssertion: Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmlenc#rsa-1_5"
Error: DecryptionError: unsupported encryption algorithm: rsa-1_5
```
dan-support: Customer acme-co reported 403 on SSO login and says they rotated their key yesterday. They're blocked.
alice.m: Two things: short-term tolerance for RSA1_5 might be needed, but medium term we should nudge customers to OAEP. also check audit logs — any missing audit entries around the same time?
bob-sre: infra-bot: query config xmlsec_policy for relevant SPs in eu-west-1.
infra-bot: (bot) xmlsec_policy for tenant group EU_CORE = "strict" (rsa-oaep only). change history: 2024-05-10 harden rollout.
bob-sre: I can flip to `permissive` for the affected tenant groups as a targeted rollback.
carol-idp: Related but separate: SCIM provisioning for tenant acme-co also created duplicate user rows during the same window. Looks like externalId came through empty from their AD->IdP sync and our SCIM fallback used `displayName` which collided across multiple accounts.
dan-support: so they have both SSO failures and duplicate users on login. not great. customer escalation happening.
alice.m: Any chance the KMS alias rotation we did last week is causing audit events to fail to write? i saw an error about encryption context when writing to audit table earlier.
bob-sre: I see audit write errors around 2024-06-04T09:12:xxZ: `KMS: InvalidCiphertextException: decryption failed for key alias/rdw-audit-rotated`. Might be a propagation gap after alias swap.
carol-idp: For immediate mitigation I'm going to: 1) push SCIM change to stop using displayName fallback (require externalId) to staging now, 2) add a de-dupe job to merge the duplicates for acme-co.
alice.m: I'll open an incident (sev3) and coordinate. Plan proposal: 
  1) roll xmlsec_policy to permissive for just affected tenant group (eu-east/eu-west) for 2 hours while we notify customers.
  2) hotfix SP to accept both rsa-oaep and rsa-1_5 for now and log metrics on alg usage.
  3) ship SCIM change (require externalId) and run de-dupe script for duplicates.
  4) verify audit write KMS alias mapping and restore alias-to-key mapping to avoid failed audit writes; re-ingest missing audit events if needed.
  5) follow-up: remove rsa-1_5 acceptance after 2 weeks with customer notice.
bob-sre: I'll take step 1 & 4. changing xmlsec_policy now to permissive for EU_CORE. infra-bot: submit config change.
infra-bot: (bot) config change queued: xmlsec_policy -> permissive for EU_CORE; will apply in ~60s. change id cchg-202406-227.
carol-idp: SCIM patch is building, tests passing. ETA deploy to prod ~90m. I have the de-dupe script ready, will run after deploy.
dan-support: telling customer ETA ~3h for full resolution, offering temporary SSO workaround (manual invite).
alice.m: also add a note to audit: we will need to reprocess audit writes from buffer for window 2024-06-04T09:00->09:30Z.
bob-sre: created incident page: https://redwood.atlassian.local/incidents/INC-2024-0643 (pinned). assigning roles: bob-sre (incident lead), carol-idp (fix owner), alice.m (security lead), dan-support (customer comms).
dan-support: thx. i'll keep acme-co updated.
carol-idp: once SCIM deploys i'll post results here. will also attach minimal repro steps for SAML assertion test.
alice.m: good. after de-dupe and audit restore let's run a short postmortem and add an eval to Redwood Optimize to detect externalId-missing patterns during provisioning. :memo: :eyes:"
